entries.79d824b7aeef4a82: It is a corporate group consisting of the company, 33 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]], one non-consolidated subsidiary and one equity-method affiliate. The company is a holding company responsible for group management planning and administration; operating companies such as GEO Co., Ltd. run the stores (as of the end of March 2026).
entries.820a47369242e7bf: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥481,249 million, up 12.5% year on year. By merchandise category, clothing and fashion accessories, furniture and home appliances, etc. were ¥155,250 million (up 17.6%); new products ¥124,333 million (up 25.5%); games, smartphones, tablets, etc. ¥87,759 million (up 4.9%); and luxury ¥57,595 million (down 1.1%).
